standards_review.notes: All 10 commit subjects in the review range use EPMCDME-15555: Description, matching README.md:163 / git-workflow.md format

New concern correctly isolated into its own module (tool_output_visibility.py) per Module Cohesion, and new/changed source carries modern type hints (str | None, list[str]). However make license-check fails: tests/codemie/rest_api/routers/test_assistant_hide_tool_outputs.py, tests/codemie/rest_api/routers/test_hide_tool_outputs_e2e.py and tests/codemie/service/assistant/test_tool_output_visibility.py are new test files with no Apache 2.0 header, verified by running scripts/license_headers/check_license_headers.py --check on those three files (Missing license header x3)

Fail-closed design matches guide's Secret Handling spirit applied to tool-output visibility: _hidden_ids() in tool_output_visibility.py treats an unresolved/deleted assistant id as hidden by default; _effective_hide_tool_outputs() in routers/assistant.py ORs master and execution-assistant flags so a version-pinned request cannot re-expose what the master hides; get_conversation_stream in routers/conversation.py now checks is_any_hidden() across all conversation assistant ids (handles mid-conversation handoffs) before deciding to strip the live stream. No credentials or secrets are logged by the new code; strip_response() only logs the response type name on an unsupported-type branch via logger.error

blocking_findings.violation: code-quality.md requires the Apache 2.0 header checker (make license-check / license-fix) to pass on source files; these three new test files have no header and fail scripts/license_headers/check_license_headers.py --check
blocking_findings.why_blocking: the repo's documented license gate (Makefile verify target runs license after ruff) fails on these files as committed
blocking_findings.remedy: run make license-fix (or poetry run python scripts/license_headers/check_license_headers.py --fix <files>) to add the standard header to the three files
